_meta.description: Heart event #1 for npc_paige: The Donation

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: You're donating a recovered Old World book? To the Archive?

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Do you understand how rare this is? The binding alone is—

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I'll catalogue it immediately. Section 4-B, pre-war literature.

options.text: I thought the Archive should have it.
I found it and thought of you.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: You thought of the Archive. That's... appreciated.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Most people don't think about preservation. You clearly do.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Thank you, Jack. This matters more than you know.
